en: Black‑and‑white image showing a group of uniformed soldiers and nurses gathered around a medical tent in a forest clearing. Several patients lie on stretchers on the grass in front of the tent while others are being attended by medical personnel. All adults wear armbands with a cross symbol, suggesting a field hospital or Red Cross training scene. The style of uniforms and photographic quality indicate an early 20th‑century setting. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the image itself.
